$comment: ★★ cl's TLS-CALLBACK IDIOM IN A LINKED OBJECT IS REFUSED BY NAME (P69 round 4, review-xa3 MINOR 4; D-LK-FOREIGN-OBJECT-INITIALIZER-TABLES-NEVER-RUN carries the work). The archive's one member is cl 19.44's `/c /O2 /MD /GS-` build of a TLS callback whose pointer `__declspec(allocate(".CRT$XLB"))` places in the callback table, kept by `#pragma comment(linker, "/INCLUDE:_tls_used")` and `/INCLUDE:dss_tls_callback_ptr`; the callback sets the value `dss_tls_member_seen` returns to 42. ✔MEASURED 2026-10-07 (`.orchestrators/p69/work/xa/r4fix/fix.log`; `r4probe/m6` for the control without the includes, which both linkers drop to 0): the same main.c built by cl and linked against this archive runs to 42 under link.exe 14.44 and lld-link 19.1.5. `_tls_used` is the C runtime's TLS directory, which no DSS link defines, and a foreign object's `.CRT$XL*` table is one the COFF reader does not carry, so the callback could never run: the member is refused at read, `K_LinkerDirectiveUnhonourable`, naming the table and the row -- not `undefined symbol '_tls_used'` with a remedy no library could meet. NO `optimizedPipelines` ARM: a refusal builds no artifact for an optimized arm to differ from.
